name: WiiM Controller
author: Ric
description: WiiM / Linkplay zone in the bar: now playing, transport, seek, volume, presets, sources, EQ, sleep timer, local-library streaming, and desktop-audio-out (lossless live WAV). Keyboard-first panel; backed by the bundled wiim CLI (local HTTPS API, no cloud).

barWidget.description: Control the WiiM zone: click for the panel, middle-click play/pause, scroll to change volume.

schema.label: Device IP
schema.description: WiiM device address (find it with: wiim discover). Empty = auto-discover at startup.

schema.label: Music directory
schema.description: Local library served to the device by URL.

schema.label: State poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the daemon polls the device for state changes.

schema.label: Local audio out port
schema.description: TCP port the speaker pulls desktop audio from (open it: wiim firewall).
